blocks.prompt: What changes in meaning between the two examples?
blocks.translation: Apa yang berbeda dalam makna atau tujuan kedua contoh?
blocks.answer: Perhatikan apakah yang berubah adalah tindakan, tujuan kalimat, waktu, alasan, atau kekuatan klaim. Klaim mutlak tidak disertai bukti. Klaim lebih terbatas dan mungkin dapat diuji.

blocks.text: Bacaan contoh: terapkan strategi di teks utuh
Bacalah paragraf Inggris berikut. Jika terasa sulit, cari kosakata yang sudah diperkenalkan, lalu temukan satu kalimat utama terlebih dahulu.

A school committee is considering digital payments at the canteen. Supporters argue that electronic transactions could shorten queues and make spending easier to record. They point to a small trial in which several sellers completed payments more quickly. Critics note that some students do not own suitable devices and that poor internet service can interrupt transactions. The committee suggests keeping a cash option while testing digital payments further. This position supports new technology but recognises that access and reliability matter.
blocks.note: Ringkasan bantuan: Pembayaran digital mungkin membantu, tetapi akses adil dan keandalan perlu dipertimbangkan. Paragraf ini orisinal, dibuat untuk latihan, bukan kutipan soal resmi.
